objective: Convertir datos reales observados y pronosticados en una alerta/recomendación temprana, trazable y útil para toma de decisiones ante activación de quebradas e inundación en los tres pilotos IRFEN, sin depender de supuestos hidráulicos no validados.
operational_baseline: v0.7.1 remains unchanged until explicit promotion

pilot_scope.name: Quebrada San Ildefonso
done_when: historical event calibration with non-event controls
action threshold or decision rule supported by evidence
end-to-end alert recommendation with provenance and fallback

pilot_scope.name: Lima Este: Huaycoloro + quebradas locales de Chosica
done_when: Huaycoloro main-channel model remains separated from local debris-flow catchments
at least one representative local Chosica catchment is validated end-to-end
observed rainfall and forecast are evaluated at the appropriate spatial scale
historical event calibration demonstrates detection without unacceptable false alarms
hydraulic/infrastructure state is represented without invented factors
end-to-end alert recommendation with provenance and fallback

pilot_scope.name: Catacaos / Bajo Piura
done_when: observed and forecast basin rainfall are available
numeric river state or defensible official proxy is automated
river-state decision rule is calibrated against documented events
end-to-end alert recommendation with provenance and fallback

global_release_gates: all scientific assets expose provenance and freshness
historical replay and rainy non-event controls are evaluated
no experimental threshold is promoted automatically
web publication passes regression and live smoke tests
a human-readable explanation states why an alert/recommendation was produced
stop_rule: Once the three pilots satisfy their done_when gates and the global release gates pass, stop feature development and run an operational validation period. Do not add new basins before this condition is met.
deferred_phase_2: additional Peru coastal basins and quebradas
non_goals_before_release: cosmetic features not needed for decisions
machine-learning models without sufficient labelled events
automatic publication of unvalidated hydraulic factors or thresholds
